description: List one seller's monitored x402 endpoints with each one's grade, score, verdict, 7-day uptime, median response time, whether a real test payment was delivered, and how many checks it's based on, plus the seller's counts per verdict. Use it after list_sellers to pick the best endpoint from a provider, or to see which of a seller's endpoints to avoid. For the full reasons behind one endpoint's grade use check_endpoint. Read-only and free; 50 endpoints per page at most.

host.description: The seller's domain, e.g. api.example.com (a full URL works too)

offset.description: Skip this many endpoints, for paging (default 0)

query.description: Part of the endpoint URL to search for, e.g. a path like '/weather'

sort.description: Order: by URL (default), best score first, or worst score first

name: seller_endpoints
title: One seller's x402 endpoints
